## Summary

The sequence is an **exact, full-length match** to reviewed chicken (*Gallus gallus*) **Radical fringe** (UniProt **O12972**), also called **beta-1,3-N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase Radical fringe**. This makes the protein identification highly confident.

- **Likely function:** A glycosyltransferase (EC **2.4.1.222**) that transfers N-acetylglucosamine from UDP-GlcNAc onto O-linked fucose on EGF-like repeats. This modification includes EGF repeats in Notch proteins and can regulate Notch signaling.
- **Localization/architecture:** Annotated as a **single-pass type II membrane protein** in the **Golgi membrane**. Its N-terminal hydrophobic region is consistent with a membrane anchor; the catalytic Fringe domain is annotated at residues **102–363** (Pfam **PF02434**).
- **Cofactor:** The reference annotation reports **Mn²⁺**; some activity is reported with Co²⁺, but not with Mg²⁺, Ca²⁺, or Zn²⁺.
- **Sequence-derived properties:** 372 amino acids; calculated mass **~41.0 kDa**; theoretical pI **~9.38**. These estimates do not account for processing or modifications.

The reference annotation also links chicken Radical fringe to limb outgrowth and positioning of the apical ectodermal ridge. These functional and developmental details are based on the reviewed reference annotation, not experiments on the supplied sequence itself.
